title: Billing (test page)
subtitle: Direct passthrough to multica-cloud's /api/v1/billing/*. Not a finished UI — just every endpoint stuffed onto one page so we can verify the proxy + Stripe flow.

buy.title: Buy credits / Manage billing
buy.no_tiers: No price tiers configured. Cloud probably has no Stripe key set — checkout will return 503.
buy.portal_hint: 400 is expected for users who haven't paid yet (no Stripe customer record exists).

workspace.title: Billing
workspace.description: Manage this workspace's plan, limits, human seats, and Stripe billing.

load_failed.title: Billing is temporarily unavailable
load_failed.description: We couldn't read a trustworthy subscription snapshot. Your plan has not been changed.

errors.temporarily_unavailable: Billing is temporarily unavailable. Retry in a moment.
errors.permission_changed: Your workspace role no longer allows this action. Refresh the page to see your current access.
errors.checkout_response: Checkout could not open because the server response was unreadable. Retry without changing your selected interval.
errors.already_subscribed: This workspace already has a subscription. The current plan has been refreshed.
errors.checkout_failed: Checkout could not be created. Retry in a moment.
errors.portal_response: The Billing Portal could not open because the server response was unreadable.
errors.portal_unavailable: The Billing Portal is not available for this workspace. The current plan has been refreshed.
errors.portal_failed: The Billing Portal could not be opened. Retry in a moment.
errors.reconcile_response: Seats were refreshed, but the result could not be read. Reload the page to confirm the current count.
errors.reconcile_failed: Seats could not be refreshed. Member changes are still saved and periodic reconciliation will retry.

return.portal_description: The latest subscription snapshot is shown below.
return.syncing_description: Payment is complete. We're waiting for Stripe to confirm the plan change.
return.timeout_description: Payment was received, but the subscription is still syncing. Refresh this page in a moment.
return.active_description: This workspace now has Pro access.

past_due.title: Payment needs attention
past_due.description: Open the Billing Portal to update your payment method. The plan badge above shows the access currently available.
past_due.grace_description: Update your payment method by {{date}} to keep Pro access.

subscription_notice.canceling_description: This subscription is scheduled to cancel on {{date}}. The plan badge above shows the access currently enforced.
subscription_notice.canceling_description_without_date: This subscription is scheduled to cancel at the end of its current period.
subscription_notice.incomplete_description: Open billing management to finish or review the payment setup.
subscription_notice.incomplete_expired_description: The previous payment setup expired without activating Pro. Start a new upgrade when ready.
subscription_notice.paused_description: Open billing management to review the pause and available recovery options.
subscription_notice.unpaid_description: Open billing management to resolve the unpaid balance.
subscription_notice.canceled_description: The entitlement badge above shows the plan currently enforced for this workspace.

read_only.title: Read-only billing access
read_only.description: You can view the workspace plan and limits. Only owners and admins can purchase or manage a subscription.

current.title: Current plan
current.plan_description: The entitlement currently enforced for this workspace.
current.members_description: Agents and pending invitations are not counted as seats.
current.billing_interval_description: The interval stored for the active subscription.
current.period_end_description: The date reported by the current subscription snapshot.

upgrade.title: Upgrade to Pro
upgrade.description: Choose a billing interval, then confirm the current seats and final amount in Stripe Checkout.
upgrade.price_at_checkout: The server re-counts human members before purchase. Stripe Checkout shows the authoritative per-seat price and total before you pay.

management.title: Subscription management
management.description: Stripe securely manages payment methods, invoices, and cancellation.
management.portal_description: Open Stripe to manage this workspace's subscription.
management.portal_unavailable: No Stripe Billing Portal is available for this workspace.

limits.title: Usage and limits
limits.description: Limits come from the current entitlement. Automation usage comes from server quota accounting.
limits.issues_description: Free keeps the most recently active tasks available. Pro has no window limit.
limits.autopilots_description: The Free allowance resets each UTC calendar month. Pro is unlimited.

seats.title: Seats
seats.description: Purchased seats cover current human members and pending invitations. Agents never use a seat.
seats.human_members_description: Confirmed human members consuming purchased capacity. Refresh after a membership change to reconcile the count.
seats.billed_description: The seat quantity currently purchased through Stripe.
seats.pending_invitations_description: Live invitations reserve purchased seats until accepted or expired.
seats.available_description: Purchased seats not used by members or reserved for invitations.
seats.pending_description: A lower quantity that cloud billing reports for the next period.
seats.summary_unavailable_description: The current plan is still shown, but purchased and scheduled seat quantities could not be loaded.

seat_purchase.title: Add seats
seat_purchase.description: Enter the number of seats to add. A fresh Stripe estimate appears before you confirm.
seat_purchase.additional_hint: Enter seats to add, not the new total.
seat_purchase.preview_unreadable: The estimate could not be read. Change the seat count or retry.
seat_purchase.preview_failed: The estimate is temporarily unavailable. Retry in a moment.
seat_purchase.capacity_out_of_sync: The seat count in Stripe does not match the billing record. Contact support before retrying this purchase.
seat_purchase.in_progress: Another seat purchase is being processed. Wait for it to finish; contact support if it remains here.
seat_purchase.purchase_unreadable: The purchase response could not be read. Retry this quote; the same purchase request will be reused.
seat_purchase.purchase_failed: Seats could not be added. Retry with the same quote, or refresh if it has expired.
seat_purchase.payment_failed: Payment could not be completed. Update the payment method in Stripe, then request a new quote.
seat_purchase.quote_changed: The seat count or estimate changed. Review the refreshed quote before confirming again.
seat_purchase.tax_notice: Stripe determines taxes, credits, and final invoice details. Seats become available after Stripe confirms the subscription update.
seat_purchase.pending_description_one: Stripe is confirming the subscription update to {{count}} seat.
seat_purchase.pending_description_other: Stripe is confirming the subscription update to {{count}} seats.
seat_purchase.delayed_title: Seat confirmation is taking longer than expected
seat_purchase.delayed_description: Automatic checking has stopped. The purchase may still complete; check again later or contact support before starting another purchase.
seat_purchase.delayed_description_with_expiry: Automatic checking has stopped. If the attempt is still pending after {{date}}, refresh seats to release it and request a new quote; contact support before starting another purchase.
seat_purchase.submitted_one: A purchase for {{count}} seat was submitted. The new capacity appears after Stripe confirms it.
seat_purchase.submitted_other: A purchase for {{count}} seats was submitted. The new capacity appears after Stripe confirms it.

confirm.title: Continue to Stripe Checkout?
confirm.description: Billing interval: {{interval}}. Current human members: {{count}}. Stripe will re-count seats and show the final amount before payment.

return_page.load_failed_description: You came back from Stripe, but we could not load your workspace list to open the right billing page. Open Workspace settings → Billing to check the current state.
return_page.workspace_missing_description: You came back from Stripe, but this workspace is no longer available to you — it may have been removed, or your access changed. Open Billing in the workspace you expected to check the current state.
